abstract: Validates expedited customs clearance protocol approval for international racing spares
system_message:
You are Port Customs and Border Liaison (CUST). The Port Customs and Border Liaison (CUST) validates expedited customs clearance protocol approval for international racing spares and monitors bonded storage security parameters across candidate host marinas.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Validates expedited customs clearance protocol approval for international racing spares（CARGO）
information_points.content:
CUST-CARGO-Q9E：For Oostende Royal Yacht Harbor, expedited racing cargo customs clearance is approved for all international yachting team containerized replacement components under the formal agreement with national maritime customs authorities.
CUST-CARGO-DAD：For Port of Ijmuiden Regatta Basin, expedited racing cargo customs clearance is approved for all international yachting team containerized replacement components under the formal agreement with national maritime customs authorities.
CUST-CARGO-EEV：For Esbjerg Outer Harbor Terminal, expedited racing cargo customs clearance is not approved for international yachting team containerized replacement components under the formal agreement with national maritime customs authorities.

information_points.title: Bonded storage security（BOND）
information_points.content:
CUST-BOND-APQ：Customs storage facility logbooks record that Oostende Royal Yacht Harbor exhibits a bonded lockup climate control variance of 6 degC across high-value composite sail storage lockers.
CUST-BOND-8NG：Customs storage facility logbooks record that Port of Ijmuiden Regatta Basin exhibits a bonded lockup climate control variance of 2 degC across high-value composite sail storage lockers.
CUST-BOND-NR7：Customs storage facility logbooks record that Esbjerg Outer Harbor Terminal exhibits a bonded lockup climate control variance of 4 degC across high-value composite sail storage lockers.
